claim: A practical range close to the variogram cutoff or forced maximum can indicate weakly constrained spatial structure and possible over-smoothing risk.
conditions: Most relevant when the experimental variogram does not clearly approach a sill within the sampled distance range.
limitations: No universal threshold applies; interpretation depends on extent, sampling design, soil process scale, and lag support.
recommended_action: Open the interactive variogram, compare constrained models, and avoid automatic acceptance when range_hit_max is true or practical range is near cutoff.
not_allowed_action: Do not force a long range simply to smooth the final map or reduce apparent local noise.
